'''2017 World Championship''' was the Players Committee World Championship in Bloomington, Minnesota, 10–13 August 2017. [[Phil Aasen]] finished 1st in Day 3. Day 2 published fifty-five constructed pairs plus four drops.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-world-championships/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Bloomington, Minnesota
* '''Dates:''' 10–13 August 2017
* '''Winner:''' [[Phil Aasen]]
